name: io.forthmatch/3pl-directory
title: Forthmatch 3PL Directory
description: Search a free 3PL directory and send quote requests that Forthmatch forwards. No sign-in.

tools.name: search_3pl_directory
tools.description: Use this to find 3PL (third-party logistics) fulfillment providers in the free Forthmatch directory. Filter by the country of the head office or Europe, a service, the store's monthly orders, a listed Shopify integration, or part of the name. Returns up to 50 listings a page with headquarters, warehouse countries, US warehouse states and services, plus each slug for get_3pl_profile. Details come from each company's own website and are unverified unless the company claimed its listing. Claimed listings come first, then the rest by name; it is not a ranking.

country.description: Country of the 3PL's head office: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as US, GB, CA, AU, NL or DE, or the English name. Only countries with listings are accepted, and the error lists them. Warehouses can be elsewhere, so check warehouse_countries in the results.

region.description: Head office anywhere in Europe. Use instead of country.

service.description: One service the 3PL lists: ecommerce (Ecommerce / DTC), b2b (B2B / wholesale), retail_edi (Retail & EDI), amazon_fba_prep (Amazon FBA prep), cold_chain (Cold chain), hazmat (Hazmat / dangerous goods), kitting (Kitting & assembly), subscription_boxes (Subscription boxes), returns (Returns), international (International / cross-border), freight (Freight), bulky_oversize (Bulky / oversize), apparel (Apparel), health_beauty (Health & beauty), food_beverage (Food & beverage), supplements (Supplements).

monthly_orders.description: The store's orders per month. Leaves out 3PLs whose checked minimum is higher; listings with no stated or no checked minimum stay in.

shopify_integration.description: true: only 3PLs that list a Shopify integration.

tools.name: get_3pl_profile
tools.description: Use this for the full directory profile of one 3PL: head office, description, warehouse countries and named locations, US states, services, industries, Shopify integration, stated minimum orders and pricing where published, listing status, the pages the details were taken from, and similar listings. Pass the slug from search_3pl_directory, or the last part of a forthmatch.io/3pl-directory/<slug> URL.

slug.description: The listing's slug, for example shipbob.

tools.name: request_3pl_quotes
tools.description: Use this when the person asks you to get 3PL fulfillment quotes for their online store. It sends one request to Forthmatch, which forwards it to providers from its free directory that fit the order volume and region, and each provider replies to the person by email. Forthmatch is not a 3PL and does not quote itself. No account, nothing to pay. Only call it after the person has agreed and given the email address providers should reply to: the email and store details go to those providers. Set provider_slug when they are asking about one listed 3PL. Limits: 5 per 10 minutes per email address and per IP address, and 5 an hour per IP address.

email.description: The requester's email. Providers reply to this address.

store_url.description: The online store, for example yourstore.com.

ship_from.description: Country or region the stock should ship from.

markets.description: Main countries the orders go to.

needs.description: What the store needs: b2c (B2C fulfillment), b2b (B2B or wholesale), returns (Returns), kitting (Kitting), cold_chain (Cold chain), fba_prep (FBA prep), other (Other).

notes.description: Anything else providers should know: SKUs, order size, timing.

provider_slug.description: Slug of one listed 3PL the person is asking about, if any.
